title_original: 수산업협동조합의 부실예방 및 구조개선에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 2 (Method of Assessing Business Status)
① The assessment of business status as stipulated in Article 2, paragraph 3, sub-paragraph (c) of the "Act on Prevention of Financial Distress and Improvement of Cooperatives in the Fisheries Industry" (hereinafter referred to as "the Act") shall be conducted according to the following classifications:
1. Sector-specific assessment: Assessment of the cooperative's business status based on the results of the fiscal year-end balance sheet, categorized by the capital adequacy, asset soundness, profitability, and liquidity sectors.
2. Comprehensive assessment: Assessment based on the results of the sector-specific assessments as described in item 1.
② The sector-specific assessments (hereinafter referred to as "sector-specific assessment") and the comprehensive assessments (hereinafter referred to as "comprehensive assessment") as described in item 1 of paragraph 1 are divided into 5 levels: 1st grade (excellent), 2nd grade (good), 3rd grade (normal), 4th grade (vulnerable), and 5th grade (risky).
③ Sector-specific assessments must be conducted based on quantifiable indicators to ensure objectivity and transparency.
④ In addition to the matters stipulated in items 1 to 3, detailed matters regarding the method of assessing business status shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries.
